sentences.text: The oldest board game rules on record hide behind a list of fortunes.
The game is the Royal Game of Ur, played since around twenty-six hundred BC.
But the boards survived, and the rules did not.
So for ages, nobody knew how to play.
Then Irving Finkel, at the British Museum, read a clay tablet copied in one hundred seventy-seven BC.
But this was no friendly game night.
Land on a rosette, and you are lucky.
Skip one, and you pay into the pot.
And the other side of the tablet?
So before you roll, read your fortune.
